column3: Finally then, brothers, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus that, just as you received from us how you ought to walk and please God, just as you are walking, you may abound still more.

column4: {"segments":[["For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality,",["@all"]]]}

column3: that each one of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
column4: {"segments":[["that each one of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,",["@all"]]]}

column3: not in passion of desire like the nations who do not know God,

column3: that no one transgress and exploit his brother in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger concerning all these things, just as we also told you beforehand and solemnly testified.

column3: Therefore the one who rejects this does not reject a person but God, who also gives his Holy Spirit to you.
column4: {"segments":[["Therefore the one who rejects this does not reject a person but God, who also gives his Holy Spirit to you.",["@all"]]]}

column3: so that you may walk properly toward outsiders and have need of nothing.
